raw_response: {"diagnosis": "On 2026-01-16 the v2 collector started emitting txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions treats both the same. As a result, v2 evening transactions (local 18:00-24:00) shift into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, which explains the spurious 2026-01-19 rows and the out-of-hours rows on 2026-01-18. The fix converts v2 timestamps from UTC to Chicago local time; all rows fall in January (CST, UTC-6), and the v2 samples at 12:0x UTC line up with legacy at 06:0x local.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
